reason: The page-chrome PR intentionally changes every site's default output: collapsed sidebar and metadata blocks, footer groups, head links, and per-page Atom files. Arm A of openapi-optin.test.ts therefore cannot equal this merge-base byte for byte. Allowance expires by itself: once this PR merges the merge-base moves, baseSha stops matching, and the strict comparison resumes. It applies only on the feat/page-chrome branch. If main moves first, arm A goes red on its next run (the consumption workflow runs on pull_request, not merge_group, so re-run it before merging): check that the new main brings no other output change, then consciously set baseSha to the new merge-base.
